issue.title: Stop sase TUI startup starvation on loaded hosts
issue.description: On a loaded host such as apollo, the Agents roster is usable soon after first paint. Hidden-surface and maintenance work no longer competes with the Agents loader through the GIL. The verified CPU hogs (plugin rescans, the Patch relation treadmill, and the app-wide link walk) are fixed. Startup cliffs can be diagnosed from telemetry alone.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md requests this work

issue.title: Memoize macro-plugin entry-point discovery
issue.description: plugin-discovery-memo: memoize macro-plugin entry-point discovery per process, keyed by a cheap install signature, so get_plugin_input_type_registry stops rescanning every entry point on every macro input it parses.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase plugin-discovery-memo as one work unit

issue.title: Coalesce deferred ToolRun glance refreshes
issue.description: toolrun-glance-coalesce: keep the ToolRun refresh marked scheduled while it waits behind an Agents load, so only one deferred chain and one glance load can exist.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase toolrun-glance-coalesce as one work unit

issue.title: Trim self-inflicted Agents-loader critical-path costs
issue.description: loader-path-trims: read the dismissed index without write transactions (which fixes its never-hitting cache), skip the repro-capture and update-receipt imports unless needed, and resolve artifact dirs only for running agents.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase loader-path-trims as one work unit

issue.title: Back off sase tool wait and join polling
issue.description: tool-wait-polling: carry poll backoff across follow slices, throttle the store-wide reconcile inside waiters, and skip re-ingesting unchanged event files.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase tool-wait-polling as one work unit

issue.title: Stop the Patch relation-index treadmill
issue.description: patch-relation-index: memoize the Patch relation index, build its edges only when the Patches pane is visible (keeping a cheap targets-only index for link-follow), take the startup build off the event loop, and debounce visible reloads adaptively.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase patch-relation-index as one work unit

issue.title: Gate hidden startup work on Agents readiness
issue.description: startup-readiness-gate: replace the 3 s release with a long safety timeout, keep auto-refresh ticks from collecting axe or reloading before release (fixing the skipped axe auto-start), and run heavy maintenance jobs one at a time.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase startup-readiness-gate as one work unit

issue.title: Make startup cliffs diagnosable from telemetry
issue.description: startup-telemetry: always-on loader disk substage timings, plus release reason and time, host load, and relation-index build counts on tui_startup rows.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase startup-telemetry as one work unit

issue.title: Move the artifact-link walks into sase-core
issue.description: core-link-index: replace the Python per-row walks behind the app-wide LinkIndex and the Patch relation projection with a sase-core inverted index memoized by the aggregate signature, with single-flight Python adapters and a sase-core pin move.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/apollo_tui_startup.md defines phase core-link-index as one work unit
